en.autopilotQ: Can it do things on its own?
en.autopilotTitle: It follows through, and more. Set it once in plain words.
en.autopilotLabel: Routines, schedules and reports that run on their own. You just check in.
en.ap1Q: Tell me if anything will deliver late this week.
en.ap1A: Will do. Everything’s on time right now — I’ll message you if that changes.
en.ap1Note: Know about trouble before it costs you. Mothership watches every shipment and warns you early, so your customers hear it from you first.
en.ap1More1Q: Flag any shipment whose ETA slips by a day or more.
en.ap1More1A: Watching them all. MS482611 just moved from Tue to Wed — I’ll flag any others.
en.ap1More2Q: Every morning, list anything running behind schedule.
en.ap1More2A: Scheduled. Each day at 8 AM you’ll get every shipment that’s running late.
en.ap2Q: Send me the delivery receipt for each shipment as it delivers.
en.ap2A: Will do. You’ll get each signed POD the moment it’s in — 3 deliver today.
en.ap2Note: Paperwork comes to you. BOLs and signed delivery receipts arrive as soon as they exist, so proof of delivery is never a search.
en.ap2More1Q: Every Friday, send me the week’s delivery receipts in one file.
en.ap2More1A: Scheduled. Each Friday at 5 PM you’ll get every POD from the week.
en.ap2More2Q: Send me each BOL the day before its pickup.
en.ap2More2A: Got it. You’ll get every BOL at 4 PM the day before it ships.
en.ap3Q: Let me know when MS482301 is picked up and when it delivers.
en.ap3A: Will do. I’ll message you at pickup and again when it’s signed for.
en.ap3Note: Know the moment freight moves. Mothership tells you at pickup and at delivery, so you can update customers without checking a dashboard.
en.ap3More1Q: Tell me whenever something delivers to the Phoenix store.
en.ap3More1A: Got it. I’ll let you know as each Phoenix delivery is signed for.
en.ap3More2Q: Every afternoon, send me what got picked up today.
en.ap3More2A: Scheduled. Each day at 4 PM you’ll get the list of today’s pickups.

zh-CN.ap1Q: 如果本周有货要延误，告诉我。
zh-CN.ap1A: 好的。目前一切准时——如有变化我会通知您。
zh-CN.ap1Note: 在问题造成损失前就知道。Mothership监控每一票货并提前预警，让您的客户第一时间从您这里得到消息。
zh-CN.ap1More1Q: 只要有货物预计送达时间推迟一天或以上，就提醒我。
zh-CN.ap1More1A: 我会全部盯着。MS482611刚从周二改到周三——其他有变化也会提醒您。
zh-CN.ap1More2Q: 每天早上，列出所有进度落后的货。
zh-CN.ap1More2A: 已安排。每天早上8点，您会收到所有延误货运的清单。
zh-CN.ap2Q: 每票货送达时，把签收单发给我。
zh-CN.ap2A: 好的。每张签收单一签收就发给您——今天有3票送达。
zh-CN.ap2Note: 单据主动送到您手上。提单和签收单一生成就发给您，再也不用到处找送达凭证。
zh-CN.ap2More1Q: 每周五，把本周所有签收单合成一个文件发给我。
zh-CN.ap2More1A: 已安排。每周五下午5点，您会收到本周全部签收单。
zh-CN.ap2More2Q: 每票货取货前一天，把提单发给我。
zh-CN.ap2More2A: 收到。每张提单会在发货前一天下午4点发给您。
zh-CN.ap3A: 好的。取货时和签收时我都会通知您。
zh-CN.ap3Note: 货一动，您就知道。Mothership在取货和送达时通知您，无需查看控制台就能及时告知客户。
zh-CN.ap3More1Q: 只要有货送达凤凰城门店，就告诉我。
zh-CN.ap3More1A: 收到。凤凰城的每票货一签收，我就通知您。
zh-CN.ap3More2Q: 每天下午，把今天取货的清单发给我。
zh-CN.ap3More2A: 已安排。每天下午4点，您会收到今天的取货清单。
